# Candidate Assessment: DOC_resume_ninety vs. DOC_posting_ten_five

## Mandatory Requirements

| # | Requirement | On Resume? |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | ✅ Yes |
| 2 | SQL | ✅ Yes |
| 3 | Linux administration | ✅ Yes |
| 4 | Git | ✅ Yes |
| 5 | REST API design | ✅ Yes |
| 6 | Unit testing | ✅ Yes |
| 7 | CI pipelines | ✅ Yes |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | ✅ Yes, all five |
| 9 | Kafka | ✅ Yes |
| 10 | GraphQL | ❌ No |

## Mandatory Match Percentage

Item 8 bundles five technologies, so the percentage depends on how you count:

- **By numbered item:** 9 of 10 = **90%**
- **By individual skill** (item 8 as five skills): 13 of 14 = **92.9%**

Both methods clear the 85% threshold, so the result is the same either way.

## Outcome: **PROCEED**

The candidate meets the mandatory threshold. The only gap is **GraphQL**, which could be explored in an interview or treated as a learning area.

## Nice-to-Have (for information only)

The resume shows none of items 11–15 (Grafana, Prometheus, technical writing, mentoring, public speaking). As instructed, this does not affect the outcome.
